name: Candidacy result
description: How a candidacy ended. Withdrawn and disqualified are distinguished from simply losing, because a candidate who never faced the voters is not the same as one who did and lost - and conflating them distorts every share calculated from the result.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Disqualified
hasDefinedTerm.description: Removed from the ballot by the administering body.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Tied
hasDefinedTerm.description: Equal highest vote; the outcome turns on the jurisdiction's tie-breaking rule.
